title: Geodesic orbit pseudo-Riemannian $H$-type nilmanifolds
summary: A pseudo-Riemannian manifold is called geodesic orbit (GO) if every geodesic is an orbit of a one-parameter group of isometries. For Riemannian $H$-type groups, the GO property was completely characterized by A. Kaplan and C. Riehm in terms of the dimension of the centre and the structure of the underlying Clifford module.
